research_scope: 14 selected capability dimensions across six CRM platforms; not an exhaustive feature catalogue
evidence_policy: Verified means the cited official source supports the specific claim in the evidence_note. A landing page is only a research starting point. Not verified never means unavailable. Salesforce product retirement notices are checked alongside older feature documentation; a retirement notice supersedes a general feature page for continued availability.

platforms.research_note: Feature records are source-level starting points, not a full edition-by-edition audit.
Product family subscriptions vary; verify the account's hubs, tiers and seats.
Einstein/AI capabilities can require specific editions or add-ons.
Feature and quota availability varies by plan; account-level limits were not exhaustively audited.
Plan and usage limits change; this inventory is not a price comparison.
Marketing and sales CRM capability varies by product plan and enablement state.
